feeds.term: (lecanemab OR donanemab OR "anti-amyloid" OR "tau-targeting" OR trontinemab) AND ("clinical trial"[Publication Type] OR phase OR efficacy)

feeds.title: 机制 · 基础研究
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.title: 诊断 · 生物标志物
feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.title: 预防 · 生活方式
feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Plasma P-tau217 for detecting amyloid clearance after donanemab in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 血浆p-tau217无法可靠监测donanemab治疗后淀粉样蛋白清除。

drug.title: A randomized phase 1b/2 trial of ABBV-916 in adults with early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: ABBV-916显著降低早期AD患者脑内淀粉样蛋白，但高剂量安全性受限。

drug.title: Lecanemab use in Chinese patients with Alzheimer's disease: a 12-month multicenter real-world study.
drug.zh: 中国患者使用仑卡奈单抗12个月未改善CDR-SB，ARIA发生率7.87%。

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非遗忘型不典型阿尔茨海默病多数符合抗淀粉样疗法资格，但需个体化评估。

drug.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
drug.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征构建的机器学习模型可有效分类淀粉样阳性人群的tau病理状态。

drug.title: Cognitive-enhancing drugs in Phase II clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease: emerging therapeutic candidates.
drug.zh: II期促智药试验多因靶点或人群选择不当而疗效有限，亟需优化设计。

drug.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Chalcones in Alzheimer's Disease: Mechanistic Insights and SAR Perspectives.
drug.zh: 查尔酮母核经特定取代修饰可多靶点干预阿尔茨海默病，构效关系明确指导先导物优化。

drug.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样单抗对早期AD疗效与安全性差异显著，临床获益有限且不良反应风险高。

mech.title: Semantic fluency predicts survival of memory clinic patients.
mech.zh: 语义流畅性可预测记忆门诊患者生存期，且独立于淀粉样蛋白及神经退行性影像标志物。

mech.title: Discovery of Anti-Neuroinflammatory Compounds in Alzheimer's Disease: Current Trends and Future Perspectives.
mech.zh: 综述抗神经炎症化合物发现策略，提示AD药物研发正从淀粉样假说转向炎症调控。

mech.title: APOE and genetic risk variants influence Alzheimer's disease onset in carriers of an extra copy of APP, with and without Down syndrome.
mech.zh: APOE及散发性AD风险基因显著影响APP多拷贝携带者的发病年龄。

mech.title: miR155, triplicated in Down syndrome, regulates the development of neural stem cells and GABAergic interneurons in Alzheimer's disease mouse and human iPSC models.
mech.zh: miR155缺失可促进神经干细胞增殖及GABA能中间神经元生成，或为AD治疗靶点。

mech.title: Aerobic exercise combined with FK866 ameliorates Alzheimer's disease-like pathology in APP/PS1 mice with NAMPT abnormality.
mech.zh: 有氧运动联合FK866通过纠正NAMPT细胞特异性分布异常，改善APP/PS1小鼠AD样病理。

mech.title: Ultrasensitive detection of blood-based p-tau217 for Alzheimer's disease integrated antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates and RCA/Cas12a system.
mech.zh: 基于抗体-寡核苷酸偶联及RCA/Cas12a系统，实现血液p-tau217超灵敏检测，灵敏度达1 fg/mL。

mech.title: [Clusterin as a biomarker for Alzheimer's disease].
mech.journal: Zhurnal nevrologii i psikhiatrii imeni S
mech.zh: 簇集蛋白（CLU）通过调控炎症、凋亡及清除机制，或可作为阿尔茨海默病诊断与治疗的关键生物标志物。

mech.title: Dorsal raphe tau pathology disrupts sleep-wake orchestration and sleep architecture in a sex-specific manner.
mech.zh: 中缝背核tau蛋白病理性破坏睡眠结构，且效应呈性别依赖性。

dx.title: Semantic fluency predicts survival of memory clinic patients.
dx.zh: 语义流畅性可预测记忆门诊患者生存期，且独立于淀粉样蛋白及神经退行性影像标志物。

dx.title: Concordance between plasma biomarkers of phosphorylated tau and tau-PET: A narrative review.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau与tau-PET一致性随疾病分期及标志物类型而异，且p-tau231早于p-tau217出现。

dx.title: Interactive Effects of Plasma Alzheimer Disease Biomarkers and White Matter Hyperintensities on Cognitive Decline and Clinical Progression in Nondemented Adults.
dx.journal: Journal of the American Heart Associatio
dx.zh: 血浆AD生物标志物与白质高信号协同加速非痴呆人群认知衰退及痴呆进展。

dx.title: Ultrasensitive detection of blood-based p-tau217 for Alzheimer's disease integrated antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates and RCA/Cas12a system.
dx.zh: 基于抗体-寡核苷酸偶联与RCA/Cas12a系统，实现血液p-tau217超灵敏检测（达1 fg/mL）。

dx.title: Valine modulates Alzheimer's disease risk in APOE ε4 carriers: evidence from two cohorts.
dx.zh: 缬氨酸水平与APOE ε4携带者阿尔茨海默病风险显著相关，或为可干预营养靶点。

dx.title: Genetic architecture of Alzheimer's disease-related plasma biomarkers.
dx.zh: 血浆AD生物标志物遗传结构揭示其与认知关联及共享遗传基础。

dx.title: Advances in biomarker discovery for canine cognitive dysfunction: a comprehensive structured narrative review and future perspectives.
dx.zh: 犬类认知功能障碍的Aβ42及比值呈分期非线性变化，类似人类AD早期代偿阶段。

dx.title: Plasma P-tau217 for detecting amyloid clearance after donanemab in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217难以可靠监测donanemab治疗后淀粉样蛋白清除。

prev.title: Digital twins in geriatrics and gerontology: Applications, challenges, and future directions.
prev.zh: 数字孪生技术可推动老年医学个性化主动照护，但临床应用尚处早期。

prev.title: Quantifying generalization error in machine learning prediction of cognitive decline.
prev.journal: The journal of prevention of Alzheimer's
prev.zh: 多目标随机森林预测认知衰退时，加入结构MRI并未显著提升跨队列泛化能力。

prev.title: Oral anticoagulant use and incident dementia in atrial fibrillation by baseline LIBRA score: a population-based cohort study using the 45 and up study.
prev.zh: 房颤患者使用口服抗凝药，尤其DOACs，可显著降低痴呆风险，且不受基线生活方式风险影响。

prev.title: Effect of increasing cognitive activity participation via calligraphy practice on salient network and central executive network in older adults with subjective cognitive decline: a secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial.
prev.zh: 练习书法增强老年SCD患者突显网络与中央执行网络功能连接。

prev.title: Creating cognitive normative data for rural Indian population.
prev.zh: 印度农村老人认知测试需按教育分层建立常模，以提升早期认知损害识别准确性。

prev.title: Effects of Physical Activity on Brain White Matter Integrity Are Region-, Dose-, and Age-Dependent: Findings From the Population-Based Rhineland Study.
prev.zh: 运动对脑白质完整性的益处呈区域、剂量和年龄依赖性。

prev.title: Corpus callosum fractional anisotropy from routine diffusion tensor imaging predicts dementia in older adults beyond clinical risk factors.
prev.zh: 胼胝体各向异性分数可超越临床风险因素独立预测老年人痴呆风险。

prev.title: Factors associated with hip fracture following a fall-associated hospitalization in older adults: a retrospective cohort study.
prev.zh: 跌倒住院老人接受DXA扫描可降髋部骨折风险，高龄女性痴呆帕金森等则增险。

intro.title: Discovery of Anti-Neuroinflammatory Compounds in Alzheimer's Disease: Current Trends and Future Perspectives.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家正尝试用消炎药来对付老年痴呆，给患者带来新希望。

intro.title: Mechanisms, Biomarkers and Therapeutic Implications of Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 大脑发炎是老年痴呆的关键推手，看懂这篇能帮你分清真假预防方法，少花冤枉钱。

intro.title: Further data to address the Alzheimer's coverage with evidence development questions.
intro.zh: 这篇综述用最新数据回答了“治老年痴呆的药到底有没有用、安不安全”，帮普通人看懂医保该不该报销这些药。

intro.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑“没电”会让人记性变差、动作变慢，看懂它，就能明白为啥老人要好好吃饭、多动脑，帮大脑省着点用。

intro.title: A comprehensive review on therapeutics and diagnostic agents targeting acetyl and butyryl cholinesterases for AD.
intro.zh: 这篇文章讲的是怎么用“清垃圾”和“修信号”的办法对付老年痴呆，帮大家看懂新药是咋起作用的。

intro.title: Metabolic therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，老年痴呆可能和大脑“没吃饱饭”有关，了解这点能帮咱们从生活习惯上提前预防。

intro.title: Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases: pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic strategies.
intro.zh: 大脑发炎会加重老年痴呆和帕金森病，这篇综述帮你看懂新药为啥从消炎入手，以及日常抗炎可能带来的好处。

intro.title: Network Biology of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Neurodegenerative Disorders: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Strategies.
intro.zh: 这篇综述把老年痴呆等脑病看成一张互相牵连的“坏网”，告诉你治病不能只盯一个点，得从整张网下手。
